text: The verdict must stop at each link. The Brown-Betha maximum, near 1.5 times the Sun's mass, is dead as a literal prediction. The earlier particle physics links face serious doubt through this chain. The heavy star test did not individually falsify them at our strict standard. CNS loses its flagship neutron star prediction, but CNS itself is not refuted. The wider family of at least five disagreeing programs also survives this test.
